description: Carico unitario di fanghi da depurazione is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idt.regione.veneto.it. The indicator describes the quantities of sludge used annually in agriculture. The agricultural use of sludge provides organic substance and nutrients. However, sludge can also contain heavy metals that can accumulate in the soil. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Unit loading of sewage sludge" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
